notes: Three transits of the same depth (1,260-1,790 ppm) and duration in QLP sectors 39, 93 and 102 (BTJD 2384.601, 3838.177, 4128.946); a linear ephemeris fits all three to 0.03 d. Coverage in sectors 12, 66, 100, 101 and 103 rules out every P = 290.72/n except n = 1, 2, 3, 4, 8. The 4.6 h duration favours the shorter periods on this K dwarf. Centroid 0.4-2 sigma per event; Gaia RUWE 1.00; nearest Gaia star with dG < 5 is 40 arcsec away. No TOI/CTOI/TCE.

The sector-95 search picked P = 8.607 d, but the epochs at odd multiples of 8.607 d are covered and flat in sectors 1, 28 and 68: the true period is 17.214 d. Four transits across sectors 28, 68 and 95 fit to 0.4 h. One more at BTJD 2062.25 sits on the start-of-sector ramp. Gaia RUWE 1.01, no neighbour with dG < 4 within 63 arcsec. No TOI/CTOI/TCE.

Two clean, flat-bottomed 6,000-6,400 ppm transits 18.137 d apart in sector 92 (the only TESS sector of this star); the epoch between them falls in the orbit gap. Gaia RUWE 0.90; a G = 16.1 star (dG = 4.2) sits 11 arcsec away and could in principle be an EB. No TOI/CTOI/TCE.
